text:
mia-fin: FYI — BlueAnchor Consulting just sent invoice INV-2026-04 for onboarding workshops ($18,750) but their PDF/email shows PO ENG-900. Concur rejects it because ENG-900 is archived; our active PO is ENG-009. Vendor says ENG-900 is the correct ref.

rob-proc: @mia-fin can you paste the invoice header and vendor email thread? I'll check if ENG-900 was ever aliased or if procurement closed it incorrectly.

mia-fin: pasted header:
```
Vendor: BlueAnchor Consulting
Invoice: INV-2026-04
Amount: $18,750.00
PO on email: ENG-900
Attachment: invoice_INV-2026-04.pdf
From: billing@blueanchor.co
```

nina-acct: Quick Q — which cost center should this hit? Our ENG-009 PO is assigned to Platform Eng (cost center 3102) and approver is Casey L., who's on leave this month. No delegation was set.

oliver-ops: We shouldn't manually pay without a matching PO in NetSuite. Two options: procurement creates a retro PO that matches vendor ref, or we map alias ENG-900 -> ENG-009 so future invoices route correctly. Procurement preference?

rob-proc: I'll create a retro PO ENG-900-RET to preserve vendor reference and raise a mapping change to alias ENG-900 to ENG-009. Will need an approver to sign off so payment isn't delayed.

nina-acct: I can approve this one-off to avoid month-end hold. I'll add an accounting note: "One-time approval by Nina for INV-2026-04; procurement to create retro PO ENG-900-RET and update alias mapping." Approving now in Concur. :white_check_mark:

payment-bot: Invoice INV-2026-04 status: Approved by nina-acct. Hold released. Scheduled payout window: 2026-03-28.

mia-fin: Thanks. @rob-proc please confirm ticket #PR-4521 for PO alias mapping and paste the NetSuite link after you link ENG-900-RET to INV-2026-04. Also vendor asked to pay via EFT instead of check; payments, please verify bank account before release. :bank:

rob-proc: PR-4521 created and linked to procurement queue. Adding vendor email and invoice PDF to the ticket. I'll update this thread when NetSuite mapping is done.
